entry.title: New: Bill 2 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX B, DEPARTMENT OF FIRE AND PUBLIC SAFETY, FEES - FIRE - PERMIT INSPECTION, ETC." The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget, Appendix B, Revenues - Fees, Rates, Assessments and Taxes, Department of Fire and Public Safety, General Fund, Fees - Fire - Permit Inspection, etc., to add a reimbursement fee for any additional cost incurred for inspections on commercial activities outside normal business hours or at distant locations, including Hāna, Molokai, and Lāna‘i.
